title: Ulyana and the Harbor
author: Coral Montrose
blurb: Zephyrine Iversen, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
